description: Zstandard conformance corpus generated by the official zstd decodecorpus tool. Each .zst frame is paired with the exact plaintext in .bin.

generator.name: decodecorpus
generator.invocation: decodecorpus -n1 -s<seed> -p<tmp> -o<tmp> <options> (one process per frame); frames rejected by reference `zstd -t` are skipped
